responsibility: Provides the shared initialization, maintenance, and finalization infrastructure for GCC’s RTL loop optimizer pipeline, and defines the pass wrappers that sequence RTL loop passes. It creates or repairs loop structures with requested properties such as preheaders, simple latches, irreducible-region marking, and recorded exits; tears loop data down when passes no longer preserve PROP_loops; and registers the concrete RTL passes for loop init, loop cleanup, invariant motion, unrolling, and doloop conversion. This file is the loop framework/plumbing layer for RTL passes rather than a specific transformation algorithm.
